title: A Weekend Hike in the Mountains
passage:
Last Saturday, Lily and her father decided to go hiking in the mountains near their town. They woke up early and packed a backpack with water, snacks, and a map. "Have you ever hiked up Sun Moon Trail before?" her father asked. "No, this is my first time," Lily said excitedly.
The trail was longer and steeper than they expected. After an hour, Lily felt exhausted and wanted to stop. "Let's take a short rest," her father suggested. "You should drink some water and eat a snack." They sat under a big tree and looked at the beautiful view below.
As they climbed higher, the air became cooler and the path became narrower. Lily's father used a compass to make sure they were going the right direction. "This path is more difficult than the one we took last year," he said. "But the view from the top will be worth it."
Finally, after three hours, they reached the summit. The view was amazing — they could see the whole valley and a shining lake in the distance. "This is the best hike I have ever taken!" Lily shouted happily. Her father smiled and took a photo to remember the adventure.
On their way down, Lily asked, "Can we come back next month?" Her father laughed and said, "Of course! Next time, we can bring your little brother, too." They walked home, tired but happy, already planning their next adventure together.

grammar: 比較級 (adj + -er / more + adj) + than：規則變化加 -er（longer, steeper），多音節形容詞用 more + 形容詞（more difficult）。例：The trail was longer and steeper than they expected. / This path is more difficult than the one we took last year.
現在完成時 Have/Has + ever + 過去分詞：表示「曾經做過某事」，常與 ever 連用。例：Have you ever hiked up Sun Moon Trail before? / This is the best hike I have ever taken!
should 表建議：should 為情態動詞，後面直接加動詞原形，表示「應該」。例：You should drink some water and eat a snack.

reading.q: Who did Lily go hiking with?
reading.ex: 文中提到 Lily 和爸爸一起去健行（Lily and her father）。

reading.q: How did Lily feel after an hour of hiking?
reading.ex: 文中寫到健行一小時後「Lily felt exhausted」(感到疲憊不堪)。

reading.q: What did Lily's father use to make sure they were going the right direction?
reading.ex: 文中提到爸爸使用指南針(compass)確認方向。

reading.q: How long did it take them to reach the summit?
reading.ex: 文中提到「after three hours, they reached the summit」(三小時後抵達山頂)。

reading.q: What did Lily ask her father on their way down?
opts: If they could come back next month
If they could take more photos
reading.ex: 下山途中 Lily 問爸爸「Can we come back next month?」(我們下個月可以再來嗎)。

grammar.q: The trail was ___ than we expected. (long)
grammar.ex: 規則比較級形容詞，直接加 -er，long → longer。

grammar.q: This path is ___ difficult than the one we took last year.
grammar.ex: 多音節形容詞 difficult 的比較級要用 more + 形容詞。

grammar.q: ___ you ever hiked up this trail before?
grammar.ex: 現在完成時的疑問句用 Have/Has + 主詞 + 過去分詞，表示「你曾經...嗎」。

grammar.q: This is the best hike I ___ ever taken.
grammar.ex: 主詞 I 搭配現在完成時用 have + 過去分詞 (have taken)。

grammar.q: You ___ drink some water before you continue.
grammar.ex: should 為情態動詞，後面直接加動詞原形，不加 to。

vocab.q: If a mountain trail is "steep," it means it is ___.
opts: very sloped and hard to climb
vocab.ex: steep 意為「陡峭的、難以攀爬的」。

vocab.q: The highest point of a mountain is called the ___.
A tool that helps you find directions is called a ___.
vocab.ex: compass 是「指南針」，用來辨別方向。
